# Alpaca paper limits, checked on a test account

Nine broker limits #8161's build order leans on, each answered by one real paper test (#8256).
Every answer is the broker's own response, dated; a refusal is an answer. The full requests and
responses for each run are in the dated `.json` files beside this one.

| Check | Latest answer | Date | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `bracket-after-close` Does a bracket with a limit entry, sent while the market is closed, wait for the open? | not run yet | - | step 4 (exit attached at entry) |
| `extended-hours` Do whole-share extended_hours limit orders work on paper, after hours and overnight? | not run yet | - | the night-market step |
| `evening-quotes` Which free feed quotes stocks from 5 to 8pm? | not run yet | - | step 5's practice pick; every price card's source and time |
| `fractional-exits` Does a bracket, or an OCO, accept a fractional quantity? | not run yet | - | the whole-shares-only first-trade rule |
| `account-cap` Is it 3 paper accounts per login? | not scriptable: an account key can't see or create other accounts under its login; the login's own dashboard answers it | - | bot garages (#5452); fresh-start policy |
| `options-extended-hours` Do options trade 07:30-09:25 and 16:00-16:15 on paper from Dec 4? | not run yet | - | the Scoreboard's game-day phases (step 9) |
| `same-day-options` What is the per-account limit on contracts expiring today? | not run yet | - | the expiry card and its late rung |
| `mleg-stock-leg` Can a multi-leg order include a stock leg? | not run yet | - | covered calls as one slip |
| `newcomer-signup` Does Alpaca's signup accept the newcomer persona (age, region)? | not scriptable: signup eligibility is a fact about a person, not something an API key can ask | - | step 5 (connect) |

## Running it

- `npm run paper:checks` runs every check whose window is open now; the rest are recorded
  `not in window` with the next window's start. `--only <ids>` (comma-separated) picks checks,
  `--dry-run` prints every order body and sends no POST, PATCH or DELETE (and writes no results),
  `--same-day-qty <n>` sets check 7's second order (default 25).
- It reads its key from `SKYNET_PAPER_CHECK_KEY` and `SKYNET_PAPER_CHECK_SECRET` only: a paper
  account used for nothing else. It exits 2 before placing anything when either is missing, when the
  key matches a bot's or a member's, or when the account isn't an empty `PA` paper account.
- Every order carries a `paperchk-<run>-<check>-<n>` client order id and is a limit that can't
  fill (check 4's 0.5-share market buy and sell-back excepted). Cleanup cancels them all however the
  run ends; anything still open after it is named here and the run exits 1.
